title: Add mandatory pre-merge QA review gate using dedicated qa account
task_summary: Add a mandatory pre-merge report-only QA review using a dedicated qa-role Jules account, fix the CI merge wait block, parse final QA verdict JSON blocks, enforce approval to allow merging, and notify orchestrator of blockages.

previous_step_review.checked: src/models/workflow.py, supabase/schema_local.sql, src/clients/local_db.py, src/core/context_store.py, src/core/workflow_engine.py, src/core/orchestrator_relay.py, src/core/coordinator.py, src/core/session_runner.py

files_changed.change: Wrote the strict QA reviewer prompt template.
Created QA review dispatcher with template interpolation, JSON verdict block extraction, child QA task persistence, and COMPLETED status enforcement.
Fixed _wait_for_checks to prevent falling through on CI fail/timeout, and modified merge_when_ready to query the DB for the QA task verdict and notify orchestrators on rejection.
Updated _poll_session to call run_qa_review_for_task synchronously when a worker task completes with a PR URL.
Updated _poll_until_done to call run_qa_review_for_task synchronously when a task completes with a PR URL.
Added comprehensive test doubles and unit tests for green/failed CI and approved/rejected QA verdicts.

assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed with user; looked up internally matching on PR head branch to prevent MC/CLI merge-check bypass.
Confirmed with user; preserved existing post-merge review as a separate pass while running pre-merge QA strictly before merging.

decisions.decision: Store qa_verdict inside child QA task context dictionary
decisions.reasoning: Fits perfectly with SQLite auto JSON serialization and transparent Pydantic deserialization, keeping the schema incredibly clean and robust.
